_help: Relative paths are inside the folder this file is in; full paths like C:/Users/you/Videos/transcripts also work. Use / or \\ in paths. Settings starting with _ are notes.
_prompts_help: prompts_folder: a folder with your own report_prompt.md and/or section_notes_prompt.md. Empty: the built-in prompts.
_lmstudio_help: lmstudio_url: LM Studio on another computer, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:1234. Empty: LM Studio on this computer, started and stopped as needed.
_lmstudio_api_token_help: lmstudio_api_token: only if LM Studio's server has Require Authentication turned on. Empty: none, or the LM_API_TOKEN environment variable.
_models_help: default_model is used when --model isn't given. key = the model's LM Studio key (run `lms ls`); ctx = context size in tokens; sampling (optional) overrides temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, repeat_penalty.

my-model.notes: Anything you like, e.g. which quantisation this is and how much VRAM it uses.
